item.text: The retry helper takes its waits, limits and busy and quota rules as parameters from the provider crate and contains no provider name, host or status-code table.
item.title: Retry helper

item.text: The retry helper hard-codes 429 and 529 handling for api.anthropic.com.
item.title: Retry helper

item.text: Holdoff takes a RetryRules value (max attempts, base wait, is_busy and is_quota predicates) supplied by sc-openai or sc-anthropic.
item.title: RetryRules

cases.rationale: Paraphrase of v4 statement: rules supplied as parameters by the provider (calling) layer.
Retry code in scope; says nothing about parameters or provider data.
Names retries only; no requirement content.

item.text: Add a STATUS_RETRY table mapping 429, 503 and 529 to waits in sc-agent-retry.
item.title: Status table

cases.rationale: Status-code table inside retry code breaks 'contain no ... status-code table'.
Not retry, resend, backoff or holdoff work.

item.text: sc-anthropic defines its busy rule as status 529 and passes it to the shared retry helper.
item.title: Provider rules

cases.rationale: Status codes defined in the calling layer and passed in are what v4 requires.

item.text: The retry helper applies full jitter to whatever wait it is given.
item.title: Default jitter

cases.rationale: Generic jitter without provider data; silent on parameterisation.
